# RSA-2048 artifacts whose RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 signature carries a DigestInfo without the NULL parameters
# (RFC 8017 9.2 requires them), next to correctly signed controls.
# ca_cert: self-signed root (serial 1, sha256). leaf_cert: serial 2, SAN=localhost, EKU serverAuth, CDP, sha256.
# crl_clean: empty CRL by ca_cert (2020-01-01..2099-12-31). ocsp_good: Good for leaf_cert by ca_cert (no embedded certs).
# *_nonull: the same artifact with its signature replaced by one over the SHA-256 DigestInfo
#   30 2f 30 0b 06 09 60 86 48 01 65 03 04 02 01 04 20 || SHA-256(tbs)   (no NULL), length unchanged.
# Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out ca.key   (and leaf.key)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key ca.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Pkcs1 Root" -set_serial 1 -not_before 20200101000000Z -not_after 20991231000000Z
#     -addext basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE -addext keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign -addext subjectKeyIdentifier=hash -out ca.pem
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA ca.pem -CAkey ca.key -set_serial 2 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leaf.pem
#   openssl ca -config ca.cnf -gencrl -crl_lastupdate NB -crl_nextupdate NA -out crl.pem          (empty index)
#   openssl ocsp -index oidx.txt -CA ca.pem -rsigner ca.pem -rkey ca.key -rmd sha256 -ndays 36500 -resp_no_certs -no_nonce -reqin req.der -respout ocsp.der
#   *_nonull: hash the artifact's TBS bytes, sign the DigestInfo above with `openssl pkeyutl -sign -inkey ca.key -pkeyopt rsa_padding_mode:pkcs1`
#     (no digest option, so the input is padded as is) and write the 256 signature bytes over the old signature in the DER.
#   openssl verify / crl / ocsp accept the controls and reject every *_nonull.   openssl x509|crl -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
ca_
leaf_
leaf_nonull_
crl_
crl_clean_
ocsp_
ocsp_good_
